DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品をご購入ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この二枚を買います。ただ、試着した別の一枚を試着室に置いたままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入品と試着室に残した商品を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll buy these two. However, I left another item I tried on in the fitting room.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tell the staff which items you are buying and which item you left in the fitting room. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お使いになった試着室は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know which fitting room you used?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三番です。青いシャツを椅子に掛けました。買う二枚には混ざっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 試着室番号と残した服を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Number three. I hung a blue shirt over the chair. It isn't mixed in with the two I'm buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the fitting room number and the garment you left there. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで回収します。青いシャツは購入されませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll collect it. You won't be buying the blue shirt, then?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、サイズが合わなかったので買いません。戻す場所が分からず、そのままにしてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入しない理由と返却場所が不明だったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's right. The size didn't fit, so I won't buy it. I didn't know where to return it and left it there.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain why you are not buying it and that you did not know where to return it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お知らせいただきありがとうございます。購入する二枚のサイズは確認済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you for telling us. Have you checked the sizes of both items you're buying?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一枚は試着済みです。もう一枚は同じ表示でも形が違うので、会計前に肩幅を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別の形の服は会計前に寸法を見たいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've tried on one. The other has the same size label but a different cut, so I'd like to check its shoulder width before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check the measurements of the garment with a different cut before paying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会計を待ちます。商品を広げられる台へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll hold off on checkout. I'll show you a counter where you can spread the item out.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。買わないシャツの回収をお願いして、購入品の確認が終わってから会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回収と購入品確認を済ませてから会計する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Please collect the shirt I'm not buying. I'll pay after I've finished checking the items I am buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Arrange for the item to be collected and check your purchases before paying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 三番のシャツはスタッフが回収します。こちらの台で二枚をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: A staff member will collect the shirt from fitting room three. Please check the two items on this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお魚をご覧ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at this fish?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 表示の五百グラムは魚だけの重さですか。氷や容器も入っているのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 表示量に氷や容器を含むか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Does the displayed weight of 500 grams refer to the fish alone? I don't know whether it includes the ice or container.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the displayed weight includes the ice or container. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この商品では内容量と容器の重さを分けています。何人分を予定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: For this product, we distinguish the net contents from the container's weight. How many people are you planning to serve?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二人分です。ただ、骨の重さもあるので、五百グラムをそのまま食べる量とは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 人数と骨を除いた量への関心を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two people. However, the bones have weight too, so I don't assume all 500 grams will be edible.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the number of people and your interest in the amount excluding the bones. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 料理に使う部分について、魚担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can ask the fish department about the portion you can use in cooking.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。切り身にした場合の量と、骨をどう扱うかを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切り身量と骨の扱いを担当へ尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I'd like to ask how much there would be as fillets and how the bones would be handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the specialist about the quantity of fillets and how the bones are handled. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 加工のご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a request for preparing the fish?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今はまだ買うと決めていません。加工後の量と追加費用を聞いてから選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入と加工は費用確認後に決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't decided to buy it yet. I'd like to hear the amount after preparation and any additional charge before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will decide on purchasing and preparation after checking the cost. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では担当が来るまで、こちらの札の商品を残しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we'll keep the product with this label here until the fish specialist arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。二人分に足りるか確認してから、丸ごとか切り身か決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人分の量を確認して商品形態を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll check whether it's enough for two people before deciding between a whole fish and fillets.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the amount needed for two people before choosing the form of the product. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この商品について担当へおつなぎします。加工はご希望が決まってから進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll refer you to the specialist for this product. We will only begin preparing it after you've decided what you want.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約番号をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I have your reservation number?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらです。証明書の受取予約ですが、氏名の表記について相談したいこともあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受取予約に氏名表記の相談を追加する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here it is. My reservation is to collect a certificate, but I'd also like to discuss how my name is written.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Add a question about the name format to your certificate collection reservation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: すでに発行された証明書の表記についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is this about the spelling on a certificate that has already been issued?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。申請で入力した名前と、在留カードの名前の間に空白の違いがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 申請名とカードの空白の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. There is a difference in the spaces between the name I entered on the application and the name on my residence card.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference in spacing between your application name and your card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受取窓口だけで訂正できるか、担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask the responsible staff whether this can be corrected at the collection counter alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。私が申請欄を埋めたので、役所の入力ミスと決めつけてはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 誤りの責任を決めつけず確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I filled in the application myself, so I'm not assuming it was a data entry error by the office.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a check without assuming who is responsible for the error. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 比較できる申請の控えはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a copy of the application that we can compare?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 携帯に控えがあります。在留カードと一緒に見せます。空白が必要かも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 申請控えとカードを比較して見せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a copy on my phone. I'll show it together with my residence card. I'd also like to check whether the space is required.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the application copy and card together for comparison. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日そのまま受け取るかは、担当の説明を聞いてから決められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can decide whether to collect it as it is today after hearing the staff's explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、訂正の要否を聞くまで受取完了にはしないでください。提出先にも表記条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正要否を聞くまで受取を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then please don't mark collection as completed until I hear whether a correction is necessary. I'll also check the name format requirements with the recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put collection on hold until you hear whether a correction is needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 氏名表記の相談を付けて担当へ引き継ぎます。予約番号はそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass this on to the responsible staff with your question about the name format. Please keep your reservation number.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知についてのお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この通知を見ました。給与から毎月お金が引かれているので、もう払ったのかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与控除が通知の税の支払いか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw this notice. Money is deducted from my salary every month, so I thought I might have already paid it.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the salary deduction is payment of the tax in the notice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 給与明細の控除欄は確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you show me the deductions section of your payslip?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この欄です。保険と税が別に書かれていますが、通知と同じ税かは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保険と税の控除欄を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: This section. Insurance and tax are listed separately, but I don't know whether it's the same tax as in the notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the separate insurance and tax deduction sections. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通知の種類と対象期間を、担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: The responsible staff will check the type of notice and the period it covers.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。毎月の控除額と通知の金額が違う理由を、自分で推測して二重払いとは決めたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 金額の違いを二重払いと断定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I don't want to guess why the monthly deduction differs from the amount on the notice and conclude that I'm being charged twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will not conclude that differing amounts mean duplicate payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通知と明細は同じ年のものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are the notice and payslip from the same year?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通知は今年届きましたが、明細は先月です。対象の年まで同じかは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資料の発行時期と対象期間の未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: The notice arrived this year, and the payslip is from last month. I haven't checked whether they also cover the same year.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain when the documents were issued and that you have not checked the periods they cover. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料を照合する相談として受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll take this as a request to compare the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。通知の対象期間と明細の税の名前を確認し、支払いが必要かは説明を聞いて決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 税名と期間を照合して納付要否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll check the notice's period and the tax name on the payslip, then decide about payment after hearing whether it is required.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare the tax names and periods, and ask whether payment is required. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 両方の資料を担当へお見せください。ここでは金額だけで納付済みとは扱いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show both documents to the responsible staff. We won't treat it as already paid here based on the amounts alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文の一品は、少しお時間をいただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: One of your dishes will take a little longer.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 連れの料理ですね。私のラーメンと同じ時に出せるか、待ち時間を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者の料理遅延と同時提供の待時間を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: That must be my companion's dish. I'd like to ask how long we'd have to wait for it to be served at the same time as my ramen.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the delay to your companion's dish and the wait for simultaneous service. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ラーメンは先に準備できます。どちらも一緒がよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can have the ramen ready first. Would you prefer both together?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一緒に食べたいですが、出来た麺を長く置いてほしいという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同時希望と完成麺を長く置かない条件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: We'd like to eat together, but I don't mean that you should leave the cooked noodles sitting for a long time.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you would like simultaneous service without leaving finished noodles sitting for a long time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 厨房で作り始める順番を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with the kitchen about the order in which they start cooking.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。連れの料理にかかる目安を聞き、長ければ私の注文を変えることも考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 時間目安次第の注文変更を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I'd like an estimate for my companion's dish, and if it will take a long time, I'll also consider changing my order.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Discuss changing your order depending on the estimated time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 連れの方も変更にご同意ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Does your companion also agree to a change?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今、本人に聞きます。私だけで二人の注文を変更せず、希望を合わせてから伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者本人の希望を確認してから二人分を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask them now. I won't change both our orders on my own; I'll tell you once we've agreed on what we want.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check your companion's wishes before communicating requests for both people. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まだ調理前ですので、ご希望をお聞きできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: We haven't started cooking yet, so we can still hear your requests.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連れも一緒がよいそうです。厨房の返事を聞いてから、二人で提供順か料理を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 厨房回答後に料理か提供順を二人で選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: My companion would like to eat together too. After hearing the kitchen's reply, we'll decide together on the serving order or the dishes.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the dishes or serving order together after hearing the kitchen's response. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 同時の提供に向けて作る順番を確認します。できた麺を置いたままにせず、結果をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check the cooking order to aim for serving them together. We'll let you know the result without leaving cooked noodles sitting around.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 五名様のご予約ですね。皆様おそろいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your reservation is for five people. Is everyone here?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 四人は来ています。一人は仕事が終わらず、三十分ほど遅れる予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 五人中一人の遅刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: Four of us are here. One person hasn't finished work and expects to be about thirty minutes late.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that one of the five people will be late. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 人数は五名のままでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: Should we keep the number of guests at five?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、欠席ではありません。遅れる人の席を空けて、四人で先に座れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 欠席でなく五席必要と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, they aren't cancelling. Can the four of us sit down first, leaving their seat empty?
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that they are not absent and that five seats are still needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 四名様を先にご案内できます。コースの開始はどうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can seat the four of you first. What would you like to do about starting the set course?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 料理を全部五人分すぐ出すと、遅れる人の分が冷めます。提供方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 遅れる人の料理の提供時刻を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: If all five people's food is served right away, the late person's portion will get cold. I'd like to discuss how it can be served.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Discuss when to serve the late person's food. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 提供時刻を分けられるか、厨房に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask the kitchen whether we can serve at different times.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。遅れる人には、入店したら予約名を言って同じ席へ来るよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 遅刻者へ予約名と合流方法を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I'll tell the late person to give the reservation name when they come in and join us at the same table.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell the late person the reservation name and how to join the group. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約名を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: May I confirm the reservation name?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: グエンです。厨房の返事を聞いてから、遅れる人の料理をどうするか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約名を答え厨房の回答後に提供方法を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: Nguyen. We'll decide what to do about the late person's food after hearing the kitchen's answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the reservation name and decide on service after the kitchen responds. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: グエン様、五名で記録しています。四名を先にご案内し、料理の提供は担当がご相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your reservation under Nguyen is recorded for five people. We'll seat four of you first, and the staff will discuss how to serve the food with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お寿司のお好みをお聞きしてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I ask about your sushi preferences?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 生魚の食感が苦手です。火の通ったものを選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 生魚の食感を避けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't like the texture of raw fish. I'd like to choose something cooked.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to avoid the texture of raw fish. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 魚のアレルギーはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a fish allergy?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、魚で体調が悪くなったことはありません。食感の好みとして相談しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 魚アレルギーでなく好みと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, fish has never made me feel unwell. I'm asking about my preference for the texture.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is a preference rather than a fish allergy. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: このメニューでは加熱した具に印があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this menu, cooked toppings have a symbol.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この印のある二つを候補にします。上の飾りにも生魚を使っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 加熱印の候補と飾りの材料を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll consider these two with that symbol. Is raw fish also used in the garnish on top?
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the options marked as cooked and the garnish ingredients. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 飾りの材料を厨房へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask the kitchen about the garnish ingredients.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。具だけを加熱した商品でも、上に生のものがあれば今回は避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 生の飾りも今回は避けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Even if the main topping is cooked, I'd like to avoid it this time if there is something raw on top.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you would also like to avoid raw garnish this time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認したところ、この二つは加熱した具だけで提供する設定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: We've checked: in this scenario, these two are served with cooked toppings only.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、その二つを一つずつお願いします。アレルギー対応の保証を求める注文ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認済みの二種類を数量付きで注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'd like one of each of those two. This isn't an order requesting a guarantee of allergy accommodation.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Order the two confirmed types and specify the quantities. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二種類を一つずつ承りました。加熱した具の内容をご案内してからお出しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've taken your order for one of each type. We'll explain the cooked toppings before serving them.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お守りについてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the amulets?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二種類いただきました。家族へ別々に渡したいのですが、同じ袋で見分けられなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 似た袋のお守りを見分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received two types. I'd like to give them to different family members, but their bags look the same and I can no longer tell which is which.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to distinguish amulets in similar bags. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋を開けて中の表示を見てもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I open the bags to look at the labels inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。袋を開けるのは構いませんが、お守り本体は開けないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋のみ開封を許可し本体を開けないと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Opening the bags is fine, but please don't open the amulets themselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Allow only the bags to be opened and ask that the amulets themselves remain closed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本体の外側に種類の表示があります。こちらは交通安全、もう一つは健康の設定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: The type is indicated on the outside of each amulet. In this scenario, this one is for traffic safety and the other is for health.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。交通安全は車に乗る父、健康は母に渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 各種類を渡す相手を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'll give the traffic safety one to my father, who drives, and the health one to my mother.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain who will receive each type. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋に目印を付ける紙は必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you need some paper to mark the bags?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、小さい紙をください。本体へ名前を書かず、袋に渡す相手を書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本体でなく袋用のメモ紙を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please give me some small pieces of paper. I'd like to write the recipients on the bags rather than writing names on the amulets themselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for note paper for the bags rather than marking the amulets themselves. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 紙を二枚お渡しします。ご自身で内容を確認してから記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll give you two pieces of paper. Please check the details yourself before writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。表示と相手をもう一度見て、入れ違わないよう一つずつ袋に戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示と相手を照合して一つずつ戻す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll check the labels and recipients once more, then put them back in their bags one at a time to avoid mixing them up.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Match each label with its recipient and put the amulets back one at a time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの机でご確認ください。表示のある面を見て、袋ごと分けてお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check them on this desk. Look at the side with the label and take them home in separate bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その写真の場所へ行きたいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to go to the place in that photograph?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、このお城を見たいです。今いる場所から歩いて行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 城の写真を示し徒歩で行けるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I'd like to see this castle. Can I walk there from where we are now?
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the castle photograph and ask whether you can walk there. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真は新発田城を指す設定です。今いる新潟市内のこの案内地点とは別の地域です。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this scenario, the photograph shows Shibata Castle. It is in a different area from this information point in Niigata City.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 近くにあると思っていました。今日の残り時間は二時間ですが、移動も必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在地と目的地が別地域と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was nearby. I have two hours left today, but I need to allow for travel too.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that your current location and destination are in different areas. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 移動方法と所要時間を確認する必要があります。帰りの予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check the transport options and journey time. Do you have plans for your return?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夕方に新潟駅で友人と会います。往復できるかを先に確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰りの約束と往復可能時間を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm meeting a friend at Niigata Station this evening. I'd like to check first whether I can make the round trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your return commitment and the time available for a round trip. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この地図で現在地と目的地の位置を確認できます。運行時刻は交通の窓口でもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check your current location and the destination on this map. Please also check the service times with the transport information counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、位置を地図で確認し、交通の案内で往復時刻を調べます。二時間で見学できると決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 位置と運行時刻を別々に確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll check the locations on the map and look up the outbound and return times with transport information. I won't assume I can visit within two hours.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the locations and transport times separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 時間が合わなければ、訪問日は別にできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: If the timing doesn't work, you can visit on another day.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は駅での約束を優先します。地図を受け取り、無理なら次回の候補にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日の約束を優先し訪問を次回へ回す条件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll prioritize my meeting at the station today. I'll take the map, and if it isn't feasible, I'll consider the castle for another visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prioritize today's commitment and explain when you would postpone the visit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが位置関係の図です。写真の目的地と現在地を分けて、次の計画にお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is a map showing their relative locations. Keep the destination in the photo distinct from your current location and use it for your next plan.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 休憩できる場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for somewhere to rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。芝生に座ろうと思いましたが、雨で濡れています。敷物もありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 濡れた芝生と敷物なしの状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I was going to sit on the lawn, but it's wet from the rain. I don't have a mat either.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the lawn is wet and you have no mat. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 屋根のあるベンチと、舗装された広場があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are covered benches and a paved square.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ベンチへ行きたいです。二人で座れる空きがあるか、ここからは見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二人用ベンチの空きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to go to the benches. I can't see from here whether there is space for two people.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether there is room on a bench for two people. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 空きは行ってみないと分かりません。ほかの方の荷物がある席は避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: We won't know until you go there. Please avoid seats with other people's belongings on them.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。空いていなければ立って待ち、芝生に荷物を置くのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他人の荷物がある席を使わず待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. If there's no space, we'll stand and wait, and I won't put our belongings on the lawn.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait without using seats occupied by other people's belongings. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you be eating as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 水を飲むだけです。弁当は持っていないので、テーブルはなくても大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 飲水のみでテーブル不要と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'll only be drinking water. We haven't brought packed lunches, so we don't need a table.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will only drink water and do not need a table. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 屋根付きベンチは、この通路を左です。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: The covered benches are to the left along this path.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。左の通路へ行って空きを見ます。使った後のごみも持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内された経路とごみ持帰りを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. We'll take the path to the left and check for space. We'll also take our rubbish home after using the area.
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the route you were given and that you will take your rubbish home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ。足元に水たまりがあるので、通路の乾いた側をお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-015-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. There are puddles underfoot, so use the dry side of the path.
